question: show customers who did their payments in 2023
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.payment_date) = 2023;

question: rank customers by total revenue in New York
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'New York' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: monthly trend of total sales in 2024
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date::date) as month, SUM(total_amount) as monthly_sales FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date::date) = 2024 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: find customers from Mumbai who spent more than 5000
sql: SELECT c.* FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Mumbai' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 5000;

question: show records group by category
sql:
-- Using product_category from orders as the primary category
SELECT product_category, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM orders GROUP BY product_category;
